name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  rubocop:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Run Rubocop
        run: bundle exec rubocop

  typescript:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run TypeScript checks
        run: npm run typecheck

  graphql_lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Run GraphQL Lint
        run: bundle exec graphql-lint

  factory_bot_lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: vglist_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Create database
        run: |
          cp config/database.yml.ci config/database.yml
          bundle exec rails db:create db:schema:load RAILS_ENV=test

      - name: Run FactoryBot Lint
        run: bundle exec factory_bot_lint

  rspec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: vglist_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Create database
        run: |
          cp config/database.yml.ci config/database.yml
          bundle exec rails db:create db:schema:load RAILS_ENV=test

      - name: Run RSpec
        run: bundle exec rspec

      - name: Upload coverage artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-report
          path: coverage/

  db_seed:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: vglist_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s

          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Create database
        run: |
          cp config/database.yml.ci config/database.yml
          bundle exec rails db:create db:schema:load RAILS_ENV=test

      - name: Run db:seed
        run: bundle exec rails db:seed RAILS_ENV=test
